## 🧠 What is Web4hub?

Web4hub is an experimental technology ecosystem exploring how **Web4, AI, blockchain, and software infrastructure** can work together.

The organization is a place for research, prototypes, developer tools, applications, and infrastructure.

## 🧩 Ecosystem

**🌐 Web4** — [web4](https://github.com/web4hub/web4) · [web4.0](https://github.com/web4hub/web4.0) · [web4-publisher](https://github.com/web4hub/web4-publisher) · [app](https://github.com/web4hub/app)

**🤖 AI** — [Lmlm](https://github.com/web4hub/Lmlm) · [Lmlmplugin](https://github.com/web4hub/Lmlmplugin) · [OmniSkel-AI](https://github.com/web4hub/OmniSkel-AI) · [awesome-ai-prompts](https://github.com/web4hub/awesome-ai-prompts)

**⛓️ Infrastructure** — identity · trust · cryptography · distributed systems · cloud · automation

**🛠️ Engineering** — programming languages · compilers · runtimes · SDKs · APIs · security · developer tooling

## 🔭 Direction

Web4hub is exploring an interconnected architecture where intelligent applications, persistent identity, decentralized systems, and developer infrastructure can evolve together.

Some repositories are research projects, some are experiments, and some are intended to become production-oriented infrastructure. **Experimentation is part of the architecture.**

## 🤝 Contributing

Ideas, implementations, documentation, issues, and pull requests are welcome. Start with the repository that matches your area of interest, inspect its README and contribution guidance, then open an issue or pull request where appropriate.
